ambiguity: Preserve uncertainty and alternatives; do not force required fields that are absent. Required is an evaluation expectation, not permission to invent.

normalization_contract.string: Unicode NFC; trim leading/trailing whitespace and collapse internal whitespace only, preserve case/content; no aliases or layout-specific regex.
normalization_contract.decimal: Parse an explicitly stated decimal number with comma/dot locale markers into exact decimal string; no arithmetic derivation to fill missing fields.
normalization_contract.date: ISO YYYY-MM-DD or the Spanish DD/MM/YYYY convention to ISO; reject invalid dates and leave other ambiguous formats unresolved.
normalization_contract.currency: Explicit COP, USD, EUR and named equivalents declared generically; a bare dollar sign without further evidence stays ambiguous.
